import pandas as pd

    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s",

)

# Python: check_dataset_exists(df, name)
# Maps: SAS EXIST() function → isinstance check + None guard
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def check_dataset_exists(df: Optional[pd.DataFrame], name: str) -> bool:
    """
    Replaces SAS %MACRO check_dataset_exists.
    SAS: %IF %SYSFUNC(EXIST(&dsn.)) %THEN %DO ... %END;
    Python: isinstance check on DataFrame
    """
    if df is None or not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        logger.warning(f"[CHECK_DATASET] Dataset '{name}' does not exist or is None.")
        return False
    if df.empty:
        logger.warning(f"[CHECK_DATASET] Dataset '{name}' exists but is EMPTY (0 rows).")
        return False
    logger.info(f"[CHECK_DATASET] Dataset '{name}' OK — {len(df)} rows, {len(df.columns)} cols.")
    return True

    """
    Replaces SAS %MACRO nobs / PROC SQL COUNT(*).
    SAS: %LET n = %SYSFUNC(ATTRN(%SYSFUNC(OPEN(&dsn.)), NOBS));
    Python: len(df)
    """
    n = len(df)
    logger.info(f"[NOBS] '{name}' has {n} observations.")
    return n
